## Tutorials

❮ String Methods

ThestartsWith()method checks whether a 
string starts with the specified character(s).

Tip:Use theendsWith()method to check whether a stringendswith the specified character(s).

### Code Examples

```
Example
Find out if the string starts with the specified characters:
String myStr = "Hello";
System.out.println(myStr.startsWith("Hel"));   // true
System.out.println(myStr.startsWith("llo"));   // false
System.out.println(myStr.startsWith("o"));     // false
Try it Yourself »
```

## Tutorials

❮ String Methods

ThesubSequence()method returns a subsequence from the string as aCharSequenceobject.

### Code Examples

```
Example
Return a sequence of characters from a string:
String myStr = "Hello, World!";
System.out.println(myStr.subSequence(7, 12));
Try it Yourself »
```

## Tutorials

❮ String Methods

Thesubstring()method returns a substring from the string.

If theendargument is not specified then the substring will end at the end of the string.

One of the following:

### Code Examples

```
Example
Return a substring from a string:
String myStr = "Hello, World!";
System.out.println(myStr.substring(7, 12));
Try it Yourself »
```

## Tutorials

❮ String Methods

ThetoCharArray()method returns a newchararray representing the contents of the string.

### Code Examples

```
Example
Convert a string to a
char
array:
String myStr = "Hello";
char[] myArray = myStr.toCharArray();
System.out.println(myArray[0]);
Try it Yourself »
```

## Tutorials

❮ String Methods

ThetoLowerCase()method converts a string to lower case letters.

Note:ThetoUpperCase()method converts a string to upper case letters.

None.

### Code Examples

```
Example
Convert a string to upper case and lower case letters:
String txt = "Hello World";
System.out.println(txt.toUpperCase());
System.out.println(txt.toLowerCase());
Try it Yourself »
```
